title: Author NOTICES.md for third-party legal notices, copyrights, and license compliance
description: Create NOTICES.md cataloging all third-party open-source components across container runtime layers, shared infrastructure services, and base operating systems, with full copyright statements, SPDX license identifiers, and license compliance notices.

title: Implement automated SPDX/CycloneDX SBOM generation in release workflows and Makefile
description: Add automated Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation using Syft or cyclonedx-gomod. Generate machine-readable SPDX/CycloneDX JSON SBOMs for native CLI binaries (sndbx, bp, bpd, sonar-mcp) and OCI container images in .github/workflows/release.yml (attached as release assets) and provide a local 'make sbom' target.

title: Author ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md for human-centric open-source ecosystem appreciation
description: Create ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md documenting sincere appreciation, technical rationale, and upstream links for the open-source projects, foundations, and maintainers that power Agent Sandbox (Podman, Valkey, Gitea, Beads bd, Dolt, PostgreSQL, SonarQube, Debian, tmux, OpenSSH).

title: Open Source Attribution, Licensing Compliance & SBOM Distribution
description: Establish comprehensive open-source attribution, license transparency, and automated Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation and publishing across host binaries and OCI container images.

title: Implement Beads Graph Issue Tracker MCP Server (beads-mcp)
description: Implement a Go STDIO JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP server wrapping bd (or bd serve OpenAPI) to expose bd_ready, bd_list, bd_show, bd_create, bd_claim, bd_close, and bd_sync tools to AI agents.

title: Implement Gitea Fleet Forge & Task Backlog MCP Server (gitea-mcp)
description: Create an MCP server interfacing with local Gitea (http://gitea:3000) to expose forge_list_tasks, forge_create_task, forge_create_pull_request, forge_review_pull_request, and forge_read_file.

title: Implement Fleet Backplane MCP Server (bp-mcp)
description: Create a Go STDIO JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP server wrapping libbp and bpd to expose fleet_send_message, fleet_broadcast, fleet_read_inbox, fleet_list_peers, and fleet_set_status.

title: Epic: Fleet Model Context Protocol (MCP) Suite for Agent Workspaces
description: Comprehensive suite of local MCP servers giving sandbox agents strongly-typed, schema-validated JSON-RPC tools for inter-agent communication, forge task tracking, episodic memory, and test diagnostics.

title: Implement multi-OS setup.sh with XDG Go SDK manager and --doctor
description: Implement root setup.sh supporting macOS (brew), Linux APT (apt-get), and Linux RPM (dnf/yum), featuring XDG multi-version Go SDK management, --doctor health check, and CONTRIBUTORS.md guide.
close_reason: Implemented multi-OS setup.sh with XDG Go SDK manager, --doctor diagnostics, and CONTRIBUTORS.md guide

title: Add ADR for Third-Party Attribution, Open Source License Compliance, and SBOM Standards
description: Document architecture decision record establishing project standards for human-readable attributions (ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md), machine-readable SBOM formats (SPDX / CycloneDX), dependency vulnerability scanning gates, and license compatibility policies.

title: Design & Implement VS Code Extension with Remote-SSH One-Click Attach
description: Design and implement a host-side VS Code management extension. Provide a sidebar tree view of running sandboxes with click-to-open leveraging VS Code Remote - SSH to open the container filesystem inside the IDE window directly, rather than terminal-only attach.

title: Implement In-Container Environment & Doctor MCP Server (agent-doctor-mcp)
description: Create an MCP server exposing env_check_connectivity, env_inspect_resources, and env_request_host_assistance (bp human escalation).

title: Implement Deterministic Build & Test Diagnostics MCP Server (test-runner-mcp)
description: Create an MCP server providing structured test runner execution and coverage gap discovery (test_run_suite, test_get_coverage_gaps) without token-flooding LLM context.

title: Implement Long-Term Episodic Memory & Reflection MCP Server (memory-mcp)
description: Create an MCP server backed by local Valkey cache and fleet/agent-<name>-memory.git to expose memory_store_fact, memory_recall, and memory_record_learning.
